name: The Darkin Glaive / The Darkin Glaive 2

values.meaning: Total Physical Damage (first cast, both strikes combined)
values.binNote: ZaahenQ#InitialDamage = Q1BaseDamage + QCoeff x bonus AD only; it contains no full-AD (100% AD) term. The wiki's total states an additional (+100% AD) component that the bin's InitialDamage calculation does not carry. This may reflect a base-attack-damage component folded in separately from the ability calculation (i.e. the underlying basic attack's own AD damage) rather than an ability-side ratio; flagging as a disagreement between the wiki's stated total and the named bin calculation.

values.meaning: Physical Damage per Hit (first cast, each of the two strikes, half of total)
values.binNote: No bin row states the per-hit split directly; it is simply half of q_1's total (see q_1 for the bin-named total and its own disagreement note regarding the 100% AD component).
No single bin row states this combined percentage; it is the product of ZaahenQ.HealPercent ([0.05,0.06,0.07,0.08,0.09]) and ZaahenQ.MinionHealPercent (0.5), matching the wiki's stated halved values.

values.meaning: Time after the empowered attack lands within which the recast can be used (and time within which the initial empowered attack must be triggered)
values.quote: can be recast within the next 4 seconds at no additional cost

values.meaning: Delay after the empowered attack before the recast becomes available
values.quote: After {{fd|1.5}} seconds of using the empowered attack, ''The Darkin Glaive'' can be recast

mechanics.claim: Both the first cast and the recast reset Zaahen's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Both casts of The Darkin Glaive {{tip|basic attack reset|reset}} '''Zaahen's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: The first cast's double strike counts as a single basic attack (one windup) that deals two damage instances, not two attacks.
mechanics.quote: Does not cause '''Zaahen''' to attack twice.

mechanics.claim: The two strikes of the first cast roll a critical strike only once, applying the same crit outcome to both hits.
mechanics.quote: Rolls {{tip|critical strike}} once for both strikes.

mechanics.claim: Each strike (both casts) applies on-hit effects separately.
Only one on-attack trigger occurs despite two strikes, so effects like Lethal Tempo/Hail of Blades only trigger once per empowered attack.
mechanics.quote: Effects that trigger on-attack or interact with the attack windup will only trigger once and thus do not interact with ''The Darkin Glaive''.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack has an uncancellable windup and gains bonus range, but no separate cast time before the attack fires.
mechanics.quote: empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 4 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}

mechanics.claim: The heal is granted only when the target was a champion, minion, or monster (not wards, plants, or structures), and applies on-attack so is not prevented by parry.
mechanics.quote: Since the healing is granted on-attack, parrying effects will not prevent '''Zaahen''' from gaining the heal.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown does not begin until after the full effect (including the recast window) completes.
The damage is tagged as basic damage and spell damage, allowing it to trigger spell effects.
mechanics.quote: ''The Darkin Glaive's'' damage is tagged as {{tip|basic damage}} and {{tip|spell damage}}, which allows it to trigger {{tip|spell effects}}.
